get.summary: Lists all broker accounts across every user. Optionally filter to accounts a given user is a member of.

post.summary: Creates a new broker account with the specified user as its initial member.

get.summary: Gets any broker account by ID (not scoped to caller).
Lists all spend accounts across every user. Optionally filter to accounts a given user is a member of.

post.summary: Creates a new spend account with the specified user as its initial member.

get.summary: Gets any spend account by ID (not scoped to caller).

put.summary:
Updates any spend account's name and type. Balance is intentionally not updatable here —
every balance change flows through an `AdjustmentTransaction` (or another transaction
leaf) so the audit trail and atomic SQL path are uniform.

get.summary: Lists stock transactions across all users. Optionally filter by broker membership user and symbol.
Gets any stock transaction by ID (not scoped to caller).

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description:
Discriminator for the concrete child class of a `TransactionBase`. Bound to a
`TransactionCategory` to scope which leaf type the category applies to.

get.summary: Lists all active whitelisted emails.

post.summary: Adds an email to the whitelist.

delete.summary: Removes an email from the whitelist (soft delete).

post.summary: Exchanges a Google ID token for Fiolyn access + refresh tokens.
Rotates a refresh token. Returns a new access + refresh token pair.
Creates a new broker account with the caller as its first member.

get.summary: Lists broker accounts the caller is a member of.
Gets a broker account by ID. 404 if the caller is not a member.

head.summary: Checks whether an active broker account exists and caller is a member.

put.summary: Updates a broker account. 404 if the caller is not a member.

delete.summary: Soft-deletes a broker account. 404 if the caller is not a member.

get.summary: Lists members of the account. 404 if the caller is not a member.

post.summary:
Adds a user to the account by email. Idempotent — returns 200 + member list if already a member.
404 if caller is not a member or the target email has no registered user.

delete.summary:
Removes a user from the account. 404 if caller or target is not a member.
400 if removing this user would leave the account with zero members.

get.summary: Lists counterparties owned by the caller, ordered by name.

post.summary: Creates a counterparty for the caller. 409 on duplicate (case-insensitive).

get.summary: Gets a single counterparty by id. 404 if not owned by the caller.

head.summary: Cheap existence check used by HEAD callers.

put.summary: Renames a counterparty. 404 if not owned; 409 on collision.

delete.summary: Soft-deletes a counterparty. 400 if any active lend/borrow row still references it.

post.summary: Creates a new spend account with the caller as its first member.

get.summary: Lists spend accounts the caller is a member of.
Gets a single spend account by ID. 404 if the caller is not a member.

put.summary:
Updates a spend account's name and type. 404 if the caller is not a member.
Balance is intentionally not updatable here — every balance change flows through a
transaction (Income/Expense/Lend/Borrowing/Transfer/Adjustment/Stock) so the audit trail and
atomic SQL path are uniform.

delete.summary: Soft-deletes a spend account. 404 if the caller is not a member.

get.summary: Lists members of the account. 404 if the caller is not a member.

post.summary:
Adds a user to the account by email. Idempotent — returns 200 + member list if already a member.
404 if caller is not a member or the target email has no registered user.

delete.summary:
Removes a user from the account. 404 if caller or target is not a member.
400 if removing this user would leave the account with zero members.

post.summary:
Creates a new stock transaction. 404 if the caller is not a member of the target broker account.
For a Dividend with a positive `Quantity` and `Price` the total is computed as
quantity × price (per-share dividend) and the supplied `TotalAmount` is ignored.

get.summary: Lists stock transactions on brokers the caller is a member of, optionally filtered by symbol.
Gets a stock transaction by ID. 404 if the caller is not a member of its broker.

head.summary: Checks whether an active stock transaction exists and caller is a member of its broker.

put.summary:
Updates a stock transaction. 404 if the caller is not a member of its current broker or the
reassigned broker (if any). For a Dividend with a positive `Quantity` and `Price`
the total is computed as quantity × price (per-share dividend) and the supplied
`TotalAmount` is ignored.

delete.summary: Soft-deletes a stock transaction. 404 if the caller is not a member of its broker.

Always returns HTTP 200 OK per Telegram webhook requirements.
Processing failures are logged but don't affect the response status.

get.summary: Lists active categories, optionally filtered by kind.

parameters.name: kind

get.summary: Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user.

patch.summary: Updates the authenticated user's own profile (display name only).

put.summary: Links or updates the authenticated user's Telegram ID. 409 if the ID is taken by another user.

delete.summary: Unlinks the authenticated user's Telegram ID.

get.summary: Lists all active users. Admin only.

patch.summary: Toggles the admin flag on a user. Admin only.

put.summary: Sets or updates a target user's Telegram ID. Admin only. 409 if the ID is taken by another user.

delete.summary: Clears a target user's Telegram ID. Admin only.

AddMemberRequest.description:
Request body for adding a user to a shared account by email. Used by both spend accounts and
broker accounts — membership works identically for the two, so they share one request shape.

AdjustmentTransactionRequest.description: Request body for creating or updating an Fiolyn.Entities.AdjustmentTransaction. Unlike Income/Expense/Lend/Borrowing, `amount` is signed here and is applied to the spend account balance directly. Use this for one-off corrections (e.g. reconciling against a bank statement).

AdminBrokerAccountCreateRequest.description: Admin request body for creating a broker account with a specified initial member.

AdminSpendAccountCreateRequest.description: Admin request body for creating a spend account on behalf of any user.

AllowedEmailRequest.description: Request body for POST /api/allowed-emails — adds an email to the SSO whitelist.

BorrowingTransactionRequest.description:
Request body for creating or updating a Fiolyn.Entities.BorrowingTransaction.
`counterpartyName` is required; `amount` is the positive borrowed sum (added to
balance).

CounterpartyRequest.description:
Request body for creating or updating a Fiolyn.Entities.Counterparty via
`/api/counterparties`.

ExpenseTransactionRequest.description:
Request body for creating or updating an Fiolyn.Entities.ExpenseTransaction. The
controller negates `amount` before persisting (Expense always reduces balance).
`amount` must be positive — it's the *full* original total. When `shares` is
non-empty the service splits it: each share materialises a paired `LendTransaction`
(counterparty's slice — they owe you) linked to this row via `ParentTransactionId`;
the parent retains the residual. `SpendAccount.Balance` still moves by the full
total.

GoogleLoginRequest.description:
Request body for POST /api/auth/google — a Google ID token obtained from Google Identity Services (GIS) in the web
client.

IncomeTransactionRequest.description:
Request body for creating or updating an Fiolyn.Entities.IncomeTransaction. Income
is money in, so the controller persists `Amount = +amount` directly. `amount`
must be positive — it's the *full* original total. When `shares` is non-empty the
service splits it: each share materialises a paired `BorrowingTransaction`
(counterparty's slice — you owe them) linked to this row via `ParentTransactionId`;
the parent retains the residual. `SpendAccount.Balance` still moves by the full
total.

LendTransactionRequest.description:
Request body for creating or updating a Fiolyn.Entities.LendTransaction. The
controller negates `amount` (lent money = balance out). `counterpartyName` is
required.

RefreshTokenRequest.description: Request body for refresh and logout endpoints — carries the opaque refresh token.

SetTelegramIdRequest.description: Request body for PUT /api/users/me/telegram-id and PUT /api/users/{id}/telegram-id.

SpendAccountRequest.description: Request body for creating or updating a spend account.

SpendAccountType.description: Categorizes a spend account as cash-based (wallet, bank account) or credit-based (credit card).

StockTransactionRequest.description: Request body for creating or updating a stock transaction.

TransactionCategoryCreateRequest.description:
Admin request to create a new Fiolyn.Entities.TransactionCategory. `Kind` is
immutable post-create.

TransactionCategoryUpdateRequest.description:
Admin request to rename a Fiolyn.Entities.TransactionCategory. `Kind` is not
accepted here — it is fixed at creation time.

TransactionKind.description:
Discriminator for the concrete child class of a `TransactionBase`. Bound to a
`TransactionCategory` to scope which leaf type the category applies to.

TransactionShareRequest.description:
One slot in the optional `shares` array on income / expense create / update bodies.
The free-text `counterpartyName` is resolved (or created) per-user; the
`percentage` is a slice in [0.01, 100] with up to 2 decimal places — values with
more precision are silently rounded server-side (half-away-from-zero). The sum across
all shares on a single transaction must be ≤ 100 (validated server-side).

TransferTransactionRequest.description:
Request body for creating or updating a Fiolyn.Entities.TransferTransaction. Caller
must be a member of both source and destination accounts; the source is debited and the
destination credited by `amount` in the same atomic save.

UpdateMeRequest.description: Request body for PATCH /api/users/me — self-service profile updates.

UpdateRoleRequest.description: Request body for admin PATCH /api/users/{id} — toggles the admin flag.
